source: Elysium testnet (chain 99801), https://testnet-rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz, answers kept verbatim as the node wrote them (trailing newline included), each with the method, params and HTTP status that asked, captured 2026-10-25. calls: the eth_/net_/web3_ methods an SDK sends, including one block (0xee63c6) holding an internal 0x6a, legacy 0x0 and EIP-1559 0x2 transaction, a transaction and receipt of each Nitro type found (0x6a, 0x0, 0x2, 0x64 deposit, 0x69 submit-retryable, 0x68 retry), the unfiltered 4999-block eth_getLogs refusal (HTTP 400), reverts with an Error(string) (Multicall3) and a custom error (NoTicketWithID), and the refusals of a malformed raw transaction to eth_sendRawTransaction and eth_sendRawTransactionSync. nitro: eth_call to every view or pure read of the Nitro precompiles at 0x64-0x72 and NodeInterface at 0xc8, signatures as OffchainLabs/nitro-precompile-interfaces (main) and nitro-contracts src/node-interface/NodeInterface.sol declare them, calldata from cast 1.8.3 calldata, decoded with cast 1.8.3 abi-decode --json; an entry with "reverted": true keeps the revert instead. journeys: deposit (Inbox.depositEth on HyperEVM testnet, message 1493518, and the 0x64 deposit it became), retryable (messages 1493519/1493520 on the parent; 1493519 became submit 0xb624..e5d3 and its auto-redeem 0x9bbe..2b4e), withdrawal (ArbSys.withdrawEth of 0.002 HYPE at position 746935, the latest confirmed BoLD assertion, its AssertionCreated log, the L2 block it names, Outbox.roots, NodeInterface.constructOutboxProof, Outbox.isSpent, and Outbox.executeTransaction simulated by eth_call and eth_estimateGas from 0x2222..2222), claimed_withdrawal (position 746823, withdrawn on Elysium and claimed through the Outbox), simulated_deposit (Inbox.depositEth of 1 HYPE simulated from 0x2222..2222 and Inbox.calculateRetryableSubmissionFee). Each journey step names its chain: elysium, or hyperevm (HyperEVM testnet, https://rpc.hyperliquid-testnet.xyz/evm).
